items.title: Butimanu, Romania
items.about: Greentech is carrying out the mechanical and electrical work for the photovoltaic park in Butimanu.
items.description: The project mobilized a team of up to 300 professionals for structures, modules, wiring, and connections.

scope.title: Foundations and Installation
scope.description: The teams marked out the rows, positioned the work sites, and installed the piles according to the on-site layout. The sequence of work fronts was coordinated to maintain a balanced pace between mechanical and electrical work.

scope.title: Load-bearing structures
scope.description: The metal components were pre-assembled, installed, and aligned in each row. The fasteners and the structure’s geometry were checked before module installation began.

scope.title: Photovoltaic Modules
scope.description: The modules were distributed in an organized manner on-site, mounted on the prepared structures, and visually inspected after installation. Working in sections allowed for the gradual handover of completed rows.

scope.title: Electrical Networks and Commissioning
scope.description: The scope of work included DC and AC wiring, route planning, and the installation of related connections. The completed work was inspected and prepared for testing and commissioning.

Butimanu, Romania—Photo 2 from the construction site

items.title: Corbii Mari, Romania
items.alt: The Corbii Mari Photovoltaic Project, Romania
items.about: Large-scale photovoltaic project, carried out by Greentech teams specializing in mechanical and electrical engineering.
items.description: Work continued even during the cold season, with up to 300 people on site.

scope.title: Preparing the work sites
scope.description: The site was divided into work zones to facilitate equipment access, material distribution, and row layout. Organizing the work in phases ensured continuity of execution, even under challenging seasonal conditions.

scope.title: Piles and Structures
scope.description: The pilings were installed according to the layout marks, and the structures were assembled and aligned one after another. Each area was checked before moving on to the installation of the modules.

scope.title: Electrical Modules and Systems
scope.description: Work continued with the installation of modules, DC and AC wiring, and the organization of cable routes. Coordination between teams was ensured to prevent delays on work fronts that were already underway.

scope.title: Inspection and Preparation for Startup
scope.description: The completed rows underwent mechanical and electrical inspections, and any issues identified were corrected. Progress documentation accompanied the phased handoff to the testing phase.

items.title: PFV Guillena 400 & 220, Spain
items.location: Guillena, Burguillos, and Alcalá del Río, Seville, Spain
items.about: Two photovoltaic sites, with capacities of 110 MW and 115 MW, carried out as a joint construction project.
items.description: Over 120 professionals worked on the piles, trackers, modules, DC and AC wiring, and commissioning.

scope.title: Site Coordination
scope.description: The two phases of the project were planned as complementary fronts, with teams and materials allocated according to progress. This organization allowed for consistent work to continue at both sites.

scope.title: Piles and tracking systems
scope.description: After the layout was marked, the piles were installed and the structures with solar tracking were assembled. The alignment of the components and their mechanical operation were verified before the modules were installed.

scope.title: Module Installation
scope.description: The photovoltaic modules were handled, positioned, and secured on the prepared rows. The teams ensured uniform installation and protected the components throughout the entire project.

scope.title: Wiring and Technical Support
scope.description: The electrical work covered the DC and AC circuits, along with the associated connections and inspections. The completed areas were prepared for testing and commissioning.

items.title: Burgos, Spain
items.about: Greentech is supplying the mechanical and electrical package for the photovoltaic project in Burgos.
items.description: The project includes surveying, pile driving, trackers, modules, cabling, and commissioning support.

scope.title: Surveying and Layout
scope.description: The project benchmarks were marked on-site to determine the positioning of the rows and organize access. The installation of the piles followed the sequence established in collaboration with the installation teams.

scope.title: Trackers and Alignment
scope.description: The tracker structures were assembled, adjusted, and mechanically tested prior to loading. Interim checks were conducted to verify the continuity of the rows and the proper movement of the assemblies.

scope.title: Modules and Wiring
scope.description: The modules were mounted on the prepared structures, and the cables were routed and secured along the designated paths. The DC and AC work progressed in coordination with the completion of the mechanical work.

scope.title: Inspections and Commissioning
scope.description: The teams checked the fasteners, connections, and condition of the completed areas. Outstanding issues were tracked until resolved prior to system testing.

scope.title: Installation Logistics

scope.title: Support Structures
scope.description: The metal components were assembled and aligned according to the project configuration. The teams checked the position of the rows and the fasteners before installing the modules.

scope.title: Module Installation
scope.description: The photovoltaic modules were positioned and secured to the completed structures, with careful attention paid to handling and uniformity of installation. The completed areas were progressively released for subsequent inspections.

scope.title: Mechanical Inspections
scope.description: The final inspection focused on the tightness of fasteners, the alignment, and the integrity of the installed components. Any nonconformities identified were corrected before the facades were handed over.

posts.title: Butimanu: coordinating work on a 300 MW construction site
posts.excerpt: Large-scale electrical and mechanical installation requires daily planning, clear workflows, and coordination among teams.
posts.alt: Work at the Butimanu photovoltaic construction site
posts.intro: In Butimanu, Greentech Professionals teams are participating in the electrical and mechanical work for a 300 MW photovoltaic park.

sections.title: Coordinated work on a large-scale site
paragraphs: Over 200 professionals were involved in the project, along with a management team dedicated to coordinating on-site activities.
Daily planning synchronizes electrical and mechanical work streams and reduces bottlenecks between stages.

sections.title: From structural work to electrical installation
paragraphs: The work includes the installation of structures and modules, cable laying, and the installation of electrical systems.
Each area is inspected before handover, and progress is monitored in collaboration with the teams involved in the project.

sections.title: Working in Construction Site Teams
paragraphs: Positions may involve electrical, mechanical, civil engineering, or coordination work, depending on the project and the candidate’s experience.
Practical experience, adherence to safety procedures, and collaboration with other teams are important at every job site.

paragraphs: Please fill out the application form and attach your resume, along with the position you are applying for and a brief description of your experience.

paragraphs: The visit provided an overview of the project’s scope, the sequence of operations, and the connection between the technical documentation and on-site execution.

Greentech Professionals SRL – Privacy Policy Last updated: June 2026

1. About Us

This Privacy Policy describes how Greentech Professionals SRL collects, uses, and protects your personal data when you visit greentechpro.ro or interact with us through this website.

Data Controller: Greentech Professionals SRL, 194 Calea Floreasca, Sector 1, 014472, Bucharest, Romania. Email: office@greentechpro.ro. Phone: +40 727 332 213.

We process personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and applicable Romanian law.

2. What Data We Collect

We collect only the personal data that you voluntarily provide to us through the application form on our “Careers” page. This includes: your full name, email address, phone number, desired position, professional experience, and any resume or reference documents you upload.

If you contact us directly at office@greentechpro.ro, we process only the information included in your email. We do not use tracking pixels, analytics tools, or any other method of automated data collection on this website.

3. How We Use Your Data

The data submitted via the form on the “Careers” page is used exclusively to evaluate your application for current or future job openings, to contact you regarding your application, and to maintain internal records of the recruitment process. We will not use your data for marketing purposes or for any other purpose without your explicit consent.

4. Legal Basis for Processing

We process your data based on your explicit consent (Article 6(1)(a) of the GDPR), which you provide by checking the GDPR checkbox on the application form. You may withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us at office@greentechpro.ro. Withdrawal of consent does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out prior to withdrawal.

5. How Long We Retain Your Data

The data from your job application is retained for a maximum period of 12 months from the date of submission. After this period, it is permanently deleted, unless you have been hired, in which case your data is retained as part of your employment file, in accordance with applicable labor laws. You may request the deletion of your data at any time.

6. Who We Share Your Data With

We do not sell or share your data with third parties for commercial purposes. Your data may be accessed by internal staff in the human resources and management departments involved in the recruitment process, as well as by our website hosting provider, which acts as a data processor within the European Economic Area (EEA). We do not transfer data outside the EEA.

7. Your Rights

In accordance with the GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict, or transfer your personal data, as well as to object to its processing. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at office@greentechpro.ro. We will respond within 30 days.

You may also file a complaint with ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro), the Romanian data protection supervisory authority, located at 28-30 General Gheorghe Magheru Blvd., Sector 1, Bucharest.

8. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or disclosure. All data transmissions on this website are encrypted via HTTPS.

9. Cookies

This website uses only essential technical cookies, which are necessary for its proper functioning. We do not use tracking, advertising, or analytics cookies. Essential cookies do not require consent under applicable EU law.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date of the last revision is displayed at the top of this page. Your continued use of the website following any changes constitutes your acceptance of the updated policy.

items.question: What types of projects do you undertake?
items.answer:
We perform electrical, mechanical, and civil engineering work for photovoltaic parks, wind power infrastructure, technical installations, and data centers.

The exact scope of work is determined after analyzing the documentation and the site.

items.question: In which countries do you operate?
items.answer: We have experience working in Romania, Italy, and Spain. For other locations within the European Union, mobilization is evaluated based on the duration, scope, and requirements of the project.

items.question: Can you handle multiple phases of the same project?
items.answer: Yes. We can handle mechanical assembly, wiring, electrical installations, testing, and maintenance. Responsibilities are clearly defined before work begins.

items.question: What certifications do you hold?
items.answer: The company holds ISO certifications and ANRE accreditation for activities in the energy sector. The documents relevant to the project can be provided upon request.

items.question: How is the mobilization deadline determined?
items.answer: The start date is determined after evaluating the site, the scope of work, and the team’s availability. For each request, we provide a realistic timeline before confirming the project.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Please use the form to provide the location, estimated capacity, type of work, and desired timeframe. We will get back to you with the technical questions needed to finalize the quote and schedule.
